# DeepSeek V4 Pro integration

## Outcome

Added model-exact support for `deepseek-v4-pro` alongside
`deepseek-v4-flash`, while preserving ChatGPT/OpenAI as the default provider and
keeping auto-review on Flash.

## Evidence

- DeepSeek's official model page identifies Pro as V4-Pro-0813 with native
  Responses API, tool calls, 1M context, and 384K maximum output.
- Bundled Codex `0.147.0-alpha.6.5` completed a provider-explicit Pro
  structured shell-tool round trip.
- The catalog contract now requires both supported model entries and removes
  unknown/stale DeepSeek entries.
- The app-server routing smoke covers Flash, Pro, and GPT independently.

## Changes

- Added Pro catalog generation and validation.
- Routed Pro new and resumed threads through provider `deepseek`.
- Added model-selectable CLI and app-server live smoke commands.
- Updated compatibility, architecture, security, README, and both bundled
  Codex skills.

## Validation

- `make check`
- provider-explicit `deepseek-v4-pro` structured tool call

## Risk

Desktop must be fully restarted after installing the refreshed catalog and
rebuilt runtime. Same-thread OpenAI/DeepSeek provider switching remains out of
scope.
